testimonials.client_zh: 深圳某无人机厂商采购总监
testimonials.quote_zh: 合作 3 年，客信电池箱从设计到量产都比欧美供应商快 40%，售后响应 12 小时内，已是我们一级战略供应商。
testimonials.quote_en: After 3 years of partnership, KeXinMaterials' battery cases are 40% faster from design to mass production than European and US suppliers, with 12-hour after-sales response. They are now our Tier-1 strategic supplier.

testimonials.quote_zh: 学员最在意的就是箱子能不能扛得住粗暴操作。客信 FPV 背包经过 200+ 学员一年使用，几乎零损坏。
testimonials.quote_en: Students care most about whether the case can withstand rough handling. After 200+ students using KeXinMaterials' FPV backpack for a year, we have almost zero damage.

testimonials.quote_zh: 我们在澳洲卖钓鱼盒 5 年，最大的痛点是海盐腐蚀。客信的抗盐雾 1000h 测试让我们产品保质期从 18 个月延长到 5 年。
testimonials.quote_en: We've been selling fishing tackle boxes in Australia for 5 years. The biggest pain point is sea salt corrosion. KeXinMaterials' 1000h salt spray test extended our product lifespan from 18 months to 5 years.

testimonials.quote_zh: mRNA 疫苗的 -70℃ 冷链是个世界级难题，客信的 VIP 真空绝热方案让我们顺利通过 BioNTech 亚太区认证，年节约空运成本 35%。
testimonials.quote_en: mRNA vaccine -70°C cold chain is a world-class challenge. KeXinMaterials' VIP vacuum insulation solution helped us pass BioNTech APAC certification, saving 35% on air freight annually.

testimonials.client_zh: 比亚迪供应链质量经理
testimonials.quote_zh: 新能源电池包运输对防护要求极高，客信是我们的首选供应商。3 年合作，零质量事故。
testimonials.quote_en: NEV battery pack transport has extremely high protection requirements. KeXinMaterials is our preferred supplier. 3 years of partnership, zero quality incidents.

testimonials.quote_zh: 2000 家门店的工具箱统一是个大工程。客信的模块化设计让我们单店设备盘点效率提升 60%。
testimonials.quote_en: Standardizing tool boxes across 2000 stores was a huge project. KeXinMaterials' modular design improved our single-store equipment inventory efficiency by 60%.

testimonials.quote_zh: 我们需要的不仅是防护，更需要时尚感。客信的设计团队能平衡 MIL-SPEC 防护和零售级外观。
testimonials.quote_en: We need not just protection, but style. KeXinMaterials' design team can balance MIL-SPEC protection with retail-grade aesthetics.

testimonials.quote_zh: 客信的红酒礼盒已经成为我们圣诞限定的标配，3 年累计订单 80 万欧元，包装和酒同样重要。
testimonials.quote_en: KeXinMaterials' wine gift box has become our Christmas limited edition standard. 3-year cumulative orders of 800K EUR. Packaging is as important as the wine itself.

testimonials.quote_zh: 5000 套战术装备箱准时交付，附三语说明书（中英法），验收一次通过，期待后续合作。
testimonials.quote_en: 5000 tactical equipment cases delivered on time, with trilingual manuals (Chinese, English, French). Acceptance passed on first inspection. Looking forward to continued cooperation.

testimonials.quote_zh: 沙漠作业环境 60℃+ 极端温度，客信电池箱 18 个月零故障，已是我们在中东 5 个机队的一致选择。
testimonials.quote_en: Desert operations at 60°C+ extreme temperatures, KeXinMaterials battery cases have zero failures in 18 months. They are our consistent choice for 5 drone fleets in the Middle East.

testimonials.quote_zh: 新冠后大量样本运输，客信的 UN3373 三层包装方案让我们 3 年无生物安全事故。
testimonials.quote_en: Post-COVID mass sample transport, KeXinMaterials' UN3373 three-layer packaging kept us biosafety-incident-free for 3 years.

testimonials.quote_zh: 矿山井下 100kg 重型工具箱，普通供应商都不敢接。客信滚塑工艺帮我们解决了 6 个矿的设备运输问题。
testimonials.quote_en: 100kg heavy-duty tool cases for underground mines — no other supplier would take it. KeXinMaterials' rotomolding solved equipment transport for 6 of our mines.
